{{Top|canon=Horticulturalist}}
A '''horticulturist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] whose field of study involved [[Plant/Legends|plant]] cultivation and the process of preparing soil for the planting of [[Seed/Legends|seeds]]. They worked and conducted research in the disciplines of crop production, plant breeding, genetic engineering, plant biochemistry, and plant physiology.
